source.working_tree: uncommitted C++ verifier and clock discovery fixes

method.sequence: One structurally qualified offset at a time. Steady P0 with a temporary existing-curve point hold and bounded PCI-targeted D3D11 graphics activity. Recheck all offset requests, P-state and counters in each baseline, applied and restored window. Repeat coupled responses from the restored baseline.
method.holding: Hold voltage is a V/F curve point request. Each prior V/F entry and the original configured offsets were read back at completion.
method.samples: Clock values are kHz. private.N.A is the programmed clock, private.N.B the corresponding counter. nvml.* comes directly from nvmlDeviceGetClockInfo. Indexed frames are zero-based and local to each GPU.
method.labels: The labels in the candidate inventory are Druta names. Raw control indices and raw counter indices are separate namespaces.
